messages:
Priya (AE): Orchard Finance wants a quick POC: streaming invoice ingestion, function/tool calls for parsing, and strict structured JSON output. Can we assemble a 10m runbook with Node SDK example, recommended streaming mode, auth pattern (ephemeral creds + EU KMS option), and rough cost for ~1M tokens/mo?
Noah (SE): I'll own the runbook. @Lee can you paste the minimal Node streaming + tool-call example and preferred defaults?
Lee (SDK Eng): Minimal snippet — use SSE for simple reconnects.
Lee (SDK Eng): ```js
// Redwood minimal stream (Node)
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
const s = client.stream({ model: 'redwood-chat-1', mode: 'sse' })
s.on('data', d => { try { console.log(JSON.parse(d)) } catch(e) {} })
// Tool call envelope: {"type":"tool_call","tool":"invoice_parser","input":{"text":"..."}}
```
Lee (SDK Eng): Defaults: batch_size=8 token_window=512. For <200ms p99 set batch_size=1 + KV cache. For sustained concurrency recommend reserved capacity.
Priya (AE): Can we also include a small schema to demo deterministic mapping?
Lee (SDK Eng): demo schema: {invoice_number: string, date: ISO string, total: number, currency: string, items: [{description: string, qty: number, unit_price: number}]}
Noah (SE): I'll add validation harness and an adapter example that maps model output to schema keys.
Rita (Security): Orchard requires SAML SSO and EU-resident KMS for sensitive data. For presales we can use ephemeral API creds and scoped logs; legal sign-off needed before any PHI. Also requesting confirm of log redaction toggle.
Dana (Solutions): Ballpark pricing: hosted ~ $600–900/mo for ~1M tokens. Reserved (committed) add-on ~ $6k–12k/mo depending on GPU. I'll make a 1-slide tradeoffs summary.
Priya (AE): Can we get a staging instance with ephemeral creds by Monday?
DeployBot: Staging deployed: orchard-poc-staging (https://staging.orchard.redwood). Ephemeral creds emailed to priya@orchard.com, valid 24h.
Noah (SE): Runbook draft uploaded: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/orchard-poc (internal). Includes quickstart, snippets, and checklist.
Rita (Security): Uploaded security appendix (SSO/KMS/audit retention).
Dana (Solutions): Uploaded pricing slide.
Priya (AE): Great work — I'll share the runbook with Orchard prior to kickoff.
